- Controls — Arrow keys and WASD to move; Space/P to pause/resume and to (re)start.
- Game logic — wall + self collision detection, food eating with growth, score tracking, and a localStorage-backed
best score that persists across sessions.
- Frame-rate-independent movement — uses a requestAnimationFrame loop with a fixed-step accumulator (8 moves/sec) so
speed is consistent regardless of refresh rate.
- No-reverse guard — can't instantly turn back into your own neck.
- Start / pause / game-over overlay with a Play button.
No external assets or libraries — inline CSS and JS only. Open it in any browser to play.
